name: dozzle
description: Dozzle is a lightweight, real-time web-based Docker log viewer and monitor. Authentication Note: When using simple authentication, you must generate a users.yml file in your appdata folder before starting the container. Run this command in the Unraid Terminal (replace admin and mypassword with your details): mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/dozzle && docker run -it --rm amir20/dozzle generate admin --password mypassword --name "Administrator" > /mnt/user/appdata/dozzle/users.yml If you do not want authentication, change the DOZZLE_AUTH_PROVIDER variable from 'simple' to 'none'.
